title: Template:Forumheader/doc
content: ;Description :This template is used at the top of certain forum pages. It is used in conjunction with template subpages such as [[Template:Forumheader/Watercooler]], which are involved in preloads and cannot therefore include the standard link to their own documentation. See [[Help:Wiki-style forums]] for more information. ;Syntax :{{t|Forumheader|Name of forum}}. [[Category:General wiki templates]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
